judgments.rationale: Adjacent work: 'Agent memory is a surface for endogenous authorization laundering' (revoked permissions surviving in agent memory), agent-access receipts, OAuth token revocation (RFC 7009) and device unbinding. No art found for a capability graph per delegation, with active probing for residual tokens and endpoints plus TEE deletion attestations and a signed residue report. Claim the probe-and-attest loop; the safety-reset embodiment adds social value.
